primitives.error.network.title: Cannot reach the host
primitives.error.network.hint: Make sure Pneuma is still running; refresh this page if the host restarted.
primitives.error.timeout.title: Waited too long; the request was cut off
primitives.error.timeout.hint: Try again; if it keeps happening, switch to another model provider.
primitives.error.missing.title: That path no longer exists
primitives.error.missing.hint: Check the folder is still there, or pick the workspace again.
primitives.error.permission.title: The system does not allow this step
primitives.error.permission.hint: Use a folder you can write to, or reopen the app as administrator.
primitives.error.auth.title: Credentials are wrong or expired
primitives.error.auth.hint: Re-enter the key under Settings → Models, then click "Test connection".
primitives.error.rate.title: Too many requests; the provider rate-limited you
primitives.error.rate.hint: Wait a dozen seconds and resend; lower the concurrency if it keeps hitting.
primitives.error.notfound.title: The other side does not have it
primitives.error.notfound.hint: Check the name or address; refresh the catalog in Settings if the versions differ.
primitives.error.toolarge.title: This one is too large
primitives.error.toolarge.hint: Use a smaller file, or compress it first.
primitives.error.server.title: The remote service failed on its own
primitives.error.server.hint: Try again later; if it persists it is the provider's problem, not your mistake.
primitives.error.unknown.title: This step did not finish
primitives.error.unknown.hint: Try again; if it still fails, paste the original text so we can locate it.
